_comment: Clips with a TikTok watermark burned into the pixels, reading '@danu_english' — a
different handle from the @impulse_english archive they were pulled from. They are
re-uploads of another account's downloads, so the watermark was already in the file
when it reached @impulse_english: TikTok's own non-watermarked renditions still show
it, and re-downloading cannot fix them. Verified visually 2026-08-02, frame-by-frame,
Listed by ID rather than by rule because nothing in the metadata distinguishes them:
format_id, resolution and description are identical to clean clips. The whole 2022
cohort is affected; 2020, 2023 and 2024 sampled clean.
Remove an ID here only if that clip is replaced with genuinely clean source footage.
